elements.element: Audit frequency no more than once per 12 months
elements.evidence: "no more than once per Calendar Year"
"upon at least 30 days' prior written notice"

elements.element: Audit performed by an independent auditor (not Vendor itself)
elements.evidence: "permit an independent auditor reasonably acceptable to Ono"
"The auditor shall execute a reasonable confidentiality agreement prior to commencing any such inspection"

elements.element: Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%
elements.evidence: "at Array's cost unless an underpayment exceeding 5% is established"

elements.element: No direct access to Customer systems
elements.evidence: "it shall not include direct access to Ono's systems"
"no more than once per Calendar Year"
"at least 30 days' prior written notice" (exceeds 15 days)

elements.element: Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%
elements.evidence: "at Array's cost unless an underpayment exceeding 5% is established"

offending_extra_words: the inspection shall be conducted off-site where possible
reasons: All seven atomic preferred elements are expressly present: annual cap, 30 days' written notice, business hours, independent auditor, auditor confidentiality undertaking, Vendor-cost-unless-5%-underpayment allocation, and express no-systems-access.

Minimality fails: the inserted "conducted off-site where possible" is an additional protection not required by the preferred position and effectively rewrites the on-site facility inspection right the parties bargained for; it should be deleted.

Minor drafting artefact to note (not a deviation): the untouched sentence still requires assistance to "Array or its authorized representative" although only an independent auditor may now inspect; conforming that reference would avoid ambiguity.
